descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Firefall' Weeping Red Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Firefall' is a weeping red laceleaf Japanese maple that is going to shock the world as a weeping red Japanese maple. 'Firefall' is a cherry red in the spring. Instead of maroon, 'Firefall' is a brighter red throughout late spring and early summer. 'Firefall' may turn to a maroon by mid-to-late summer. Fall color on 'Firefall' is on fire in the fall with a bright orange red. 'Firefall' may reach 4-5 ft in height by 5-6 ft in width in 10 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Firefall' 垂枝红叶日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Firefall' 是一个垂枝型红叶羽裂日本枫，作为垂枝红叶品种，它的表现十分惊艳。 'Firefall' 春季叶色为樱桃红。 不同于偏栗红色的类型，'Firefall' 在晚春至初夏期间一直保持更为明亮的红色。 到夏季中后期，它可能会转为栗红色。 秋季叶色如火般鲜明，呈亮橙红色。 'Firefall' 在 10 年内可长至约 4-5 英尺高、5-6 英尺宽。
